sections.headline: Questions & Details
sections.subheadline: Everything you need to know before your visit.

items.question: Do you offer plant-based milk options?
items.answer: Yes, we proudly serve barista-grade oat, almond, and macadamia milks for any of our espresso or matcha beverages.

items.question: Is there reliable Wi-Fi for working?
items.answer: Absolutely. High-speed fiber internet is available for all seated guests, and we provide dedicated work tables with access to outlets.

items.question: Do you take table reservations?
items.answer: We operate purely on a walk-in basis, but with seating across two floors and an outdoor patio, you can usually find a comfortable spot.

items.question: Are your pastries vegan or gluten-free?
items.answer: We offer a rotating daily selection of vegan and gluten-friendly baked goods. Please ask our baristas about today's specific offerings.
